textSizePreview: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him

hapticOnComplete.title: Haptic when complete
hapticOnComplete.hint: A strong vibration when a dhikr's count reaches zero

hapticOnTap.title: Haptic on every tap
hapticOnTap.hint: A light tick each time you tap a card

hideCompleted.title: Hide completed cards
hideCompleted.hint: A card fades away once its count reaches zero

progress.title: Reset all counters?
progress.message: All of today's adhkar counters will go back to zero. This can't be undone.

cache.title: Clear the cache?
cache.message: Saved search results and prayer times will be deleted and reloaded when needed. Your favorites and settings won't change.

settings.title: Restore default settings?
settings.message: Theme, text size, reading options and adhan reminders go back to their defaults. Your favorites and counters won't change.

all.title: Delete all app data?
all.message: Favorites, counters, settings and cache will all be deleted, as if the app were freshly installed. This can't be undone.

recitations.title: Delete saved recitations?
recitations.message: Recitation files saved on your device will be deleted and downloaded again when you listen.

quran.title: Delete Quran data?
quran.message: Your reading bookmark, saved ayahs, highlights and current khatma will be deleted. This can't be undone.

soundHints.custom: Pick an audio file from your device
soundHints.customNotice: Plays in the app; notifications use the default adhan

hanafiAsr.title: Hanafi Asr
hanafiAsr.hint: Asr starts later, when an object's shadow is twice its length

showPrefix.title: Show opening
showPrefix.hint: The line before the zikr, like the basmala

showSuffix.title: Show note
showSuffix.hint: The reference or note after the zikr

showVirtue.title: Show virtue
showVirtue.hint: The reward and virtue of the zikr

showSource.title: Show source
showSource.hint: The hadith book or verse it comes from

sourcesHint: Everything else in the app is stored on your device and works offline. These services are only used for the features below.

everyayah.name: EveryAyah
everyayah.usage: Quran recitation audio, saved on your device after the first play

dorar.name: Dorar.net
dorar.usage: Online hadith search with authenticity grades

openstreetmap.name: OpenStreetMap
openstreetmap.usage: Your city name for prayer times

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.hint: What the app stores and which services it contacts

dataHint: Clear saved progress, downloaded recitations and settings. Each option asks for confirmation first, and cleared data can't be restored.
followDeveloperHint: Get in touch, share feedback or follow new updates

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.window: Reminders arrive only between 7 AM and 10 PM

dhikr.title: Dhikr notifications
dhikr.hint: A short dhikr or dua at the interval you choose

quran.title: Verse notifications
quran.hint: A verse from the Quran at the interval you choose

paletteApplyingHint: Just a moment while the app updates its colors
paletteIconHint: The home screen icon updates after you leave the app and your phone's screen turns off.
